text: This staff report is about a matter that Scarborough Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. ME Living Limited Partnership are constructing a 28 storey and a 14 storey condominium buildings 10 to 20 Meadowglen Place. The site is located between Markham Road and Meadowglen Place north of Brimorton Drive. Transportation Services is requesting authorization to close the west sidewalk and a 2.7-metre-wide portion of the southbound curb lane on Meadowglen Place, between a point 35 metres north of Brimorton Drive a point 45 metres further north, for a period of 37 months (i.e., April 26, 2021 to May 31, 2024) to accommodate a construction staging area. Designated Roman Abraham Boulevard, between Meadowglen Place and Markham Road as one-way westbound at all times. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Meadowglen Place, between Brimorton Drive and north end of Meadowglen Place. 4.
